n9a39e61261.headline: China told it faces 'fork in the road' as officials meet CEOs
n9a39e61261.summary: IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva said China must reinvent its economic policies to speed resolution of its property crisis and boost domestic consumption and productivity. She described China as at a fork in the road.
n9a39e61261.why: The IMF monitors global economic health and its assessments of China influence views on the world's second-largest economy and its trading partners.

n8195c7aa7f.headline: China blocks use of Intel and AMD chips in government computers, FT reports
n8195c7aa7f.summary: New Chinese rules reportedly block the use of Intel and AMD chips in government computers and seek to sideline Microsoft's Windows operating system, the Financial Times reported. The rules are part of a broader technology push.
n8195c7aa7f.why: Intel and AMD derive significant revenue from China, and government procurement restrictions can reshape demand for US chip and software vendors.

impacts.name: Intel
impacts.why: Chinese government computers will no longer be able to use Intel chips, removing a segment of demand.
